newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gilt prices slightly up in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian gilt prices slightly up in light trade.

text.p: * Prices of Indian government securities slightly up in afternoon trade Monday but volumes small, dealers said.
* Expectations of easing domestic liquidity triggers buying interest, dealers said.
* "Sentiment has improved as call money has eased," said a dealer. "Market expectations are that call will ease below 6.0 percent by the end of the week."
* In latest deals, the 12.69 percent 2002 stock improves to 100.35 rupees from last traded 100.23, 13.50 percent 1998 to 103 from 102.92 and the 13.05 2007 to 100.74 from 100.70.
* April 1998 maturity treasury bill traded at a yield of 9.3 percent, January bill at 9.25 percent, dealers said.
